allowedSourceMaterial.overview: When terrorists try to seize control of a Berlin-Paris flight, a soft-spoken young American co-pilot struggles to save the lives of the passengers and crew while forging a surprising connection with one of the hijackers.

facts.overview: When terrorists try to seize control of a Berlin-Paris flight, a soft-spoken young American co-pilot struggles to save the lives of the passengers and crew while forging a surprising connection with one of the hijackers.

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: As the cockpit becomes a high-stakes standoff, the co-pilot begins to forge an unexpected connection with one of the hijackers.
visibleEditorialCopy.description: On a flight from Berlin to Paris, terrorists attempt to seize the aircraft, leaving a soft-spoken American co-pilot fighting to protect the passengers and crew under extreme pressure.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Fast-moving, immersive, and relentlessly tense, delivering compact suspense ideal for focused solo viewing.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Director Patrick Vollrath crafts an intensely focused in-flight thriller that transforms an urgent airborne crisis into a compact, human-scale battle of nerves.
